Journeys of Aspiration

What it takes to make a home.

Made withAspora
Our partVisual identity · Content strategy · International production

Here’s the idea.

Personal stories of building a life abroad, filmed across the UK and UAE.

Families, couples, founders, a Michelin-star chef, and a Formula 2 driver share how they built new homes, careers, and identities.

The series looks beyond nostalgia to the choices and work behind those lives. Mid-form stories and short-form extensions bring the same human perspective to different viewing habits.

The story of moving away is also the story of building something new.
